text.p: ICI Pakistan, a subsidiary of Imperial Chemical Industries Plc, dropped 1.25 rupees, or 4.68 percent, to 25.45 on what dealers said were disappointing results for calendar 1996.
Some 4.425 million shares of the stock had changed hands at the Karachi Stock Exchange by midsession.
"ICI's earnings don't justify its current prices. The stock is likely to slip further and settle at around 20 or 21 rupees," dealer Mudassar Malik of BMA Capital Management said.
"ICI prices surged sharply during the recent rally from the level of 17 rupees to 29 rupees or so," he added.
On February 23 ICI Pakistan announced an after-tax profit of 542 million rupees for calendar 1996 against 589 million in 1995.
